info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Salesforce Bulk API 2.0
info.description:
Optimized API for loading, updating, or deleting large data sets asynchronously with better performance than REST API. Supports ingest (insert, update, upsert, delete) and query operations on large volumes of records using CSV data format. Designed for ETL workflows and mass data operations.

Contact Support:
 Name: Salesforce Developer Support
